overall: AG found no violation: the Board properly approved the clerical union MOU in executive session under Purpose 3 after the chair's declaration, and later signing was an administrative task.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged three selectmen deliberated outside a posted meeting by signing the clerical union MOU, which was never approved or ratified in open session.
allegations.key_passage: discussed and approved during a meeting is an administrative task, outside of the definition of deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the union contract was approved in executive session and never ratified in open session, contrary to the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because there are circumstances in which both the bargaining and litigating positions of a public body may be detrimentally affected by voting on a final collective bargaining agreement in the open, contract approval may occur in executive session if the chair makes the appropriate declaration that such circumstances are present.
